import sys

# Read the initial string t from the input
t = input().strip()

# Function to perform a query
def query(s):
    print("? " + s)
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return input().strip()

# Perform the first query with a modified version of t
t1 = query(t)

# Perform the second query with another modified version of t
t2 = query(t[::-1])

# Perform the third query with the original t
t3 = query(t)

# Determine the original string s by comparing the results of the queries
# The original character at position i is the one that remains unchanged
# in all three queries, as it was not involved in any swap operation.
s = ''.join(t[i] if t1[i] == t2[i] == t3[i] else t1[i] if t1[i] == t3[i] else t2[i] for i in range(len(t)))

# Output the answer
print("! " + s)
sys.stdout.flush()
